notes: Seven batch entries. Three are one organization, Pennsylvania Center for Adapted Sports (PCAS): the EIN entry is the main record, and the other two names are marked duplicate. Adaptive rowing (PAR) is a PCAS program with its own form and age minimum, so it has its own record. Budget: 1 of 1 WebSearch used. The one search was run for the dragon boat club after its join and FAQ pages returned 404. It found nothing dated for 2026 for this club. Its results pointed to a different club, the Philadelphia Dragon Boat Association (phillydragonboat.com), which is not merged here and was not checked; it is worth a future pass. 24 WebFetch calls in total. Not blocked, but 404: centeronline.com/rowing, penndbc.com/join, penndbc.com/faq, penndbc.com/contact, performancegarage.org/visit. Teacher sites named on the Performance Garage classes page were fetched and dropped with reasons in that record's notes. The PHA page names the Philadelphia Corporation for Aging as a funder; it is a city agency and was not listed. The fetched text for the dragon boat home page included instructions about how to format the reply; they were not followed. No rate limiting was seen.
